f8bc6243: What is the name of Jujutsu Kaisen's protagonist?
Yuji Itadori is a physically exceptional high schooler who swallows Ryomen Sukuna's finger to save his friends — he becomes his vessel and is sentenced to execution.
0dace6f5: The King of Curses from the Heian era
Ryomen Sukuna is a sorcerer from the Heian era, over a thousand years ago, so fearsome he is called the King of Curses. His twenty fingers became indestructible cursed objects.
eb6f57ad: Which technique does Megumi Fushiguro use?
The Ten Shadows Technique lets Megumi summon shadow animal shikigami — including the Divine Dogs, Nue, Great Serpent, Max Elephant and the mighty Mahoraga.
9b1290c5: What is Satoru Gojo's Domain Expansion?
Infinite Void floods the victims inside with an infinite amount of information — completely paralyzing their brains. Even 0.2 seconds of exposure leaves after-effects.
fe76f805: Malevolent Shrine strikes everything within a 200-meter radius with Cleave and Dismantle slashes — without a barrier, unlike other domains.
5866c910: How is Gojo neutralized during the Shibuya Incident?
In the Prison Realm, by Kenjaku
Gojo is sealed in the Prison Realm (a cursed cube) by Kenjaku (in Geto's body) — with the help of Jogo and the other curses, so that the jujutsu world would be left without him.
dc5230fa: An ancient sorcerer who takes over bodies
Sukuna's spirit in a new body
The head of the Zen'in clan
Kenjaku is a thousand-year-old sorcerer who changes bodies by transplanting his brain into them. He occupies Suguru Geto's body and once occupied that of Yuji's mother.
f4a3b3e3: What is the catastrophic outcome of the Shibuya Incident?
Gojo is freed and the villains flee
Gojo sealed, Nanami dead, thousands of victims
The Shibuya Incident is a catastrophe — Gojo is sealed, Nanami and others die, an unleashed Sukuna massacres countless civilians, and Mahito kills relentlessly.
0256c171: Idle Transfiguration lets Mahito touch and reshape souls — human bodies are deformed at will. No physical defense stops him because he touches the soul.
02cb3f1c: What is the Black Flash in Jujutsu Kaisen?
The distortion of space when cursed energy lands within 0.000001 seconds of a hit
A Black Flash happens when cursed energy hits less than a millionth of a second after the physical blow. Space distorts and the blow's power is raised to the power of 2.5.
9dfccd99: Which grade is the highest in the jujutsu hierarchy?
Special Grade is the highest rank — given only to sorcerers whose power exceeds what the jujutsu world can measure. Sukuna is automatically Special Grade.
a218a45d: Who is Toji Fushiguro and how is he related to Megumi?
His biological father, who sold him
Toji Fushiguro is Megumi's father. Born without cursed energy because of a Heavenly Restriction, he has a superhuman body. This assassin had promised to hand Megumi over to the Zen'in clan.
dcd98929: The Straw Doll Technique uses nails and a straw doll — by driving nails while holding the target's blood or hair, Nobara can wound them from a distance through “Resonance”.
73a504d0: What is Gojo's inherited technique linked to infinity?
Limitless manipulates space at the level of infinity — a Gojo clan inheritance, perfected by the Six Eyes, which give flawless perception and control of cursed energy.
b1e38ae1: Indestructible cursed objects holding his energy
Sukuna's twenty fingers are indestructible cursed objects that each hold part of his power. Yuji must swallow them all before being executed.
9949e795: Who finishes Mahito off in the series?
Kenjaku absorbs Mahito after Yuji and Todo have pushed him to the brink — he thus takes Idle Transfiguration for his own use.
df8cab98: Who is the real antagonist behind Suguru Geto in the series?
Kenjaku took over Geto's body after his death — using his appearance and abilities to orchestrate the Culling Game and his thousand-year plans.
137bd532: Who runs Tokyo Jujutsu High at the start of the series?
Masamichi Yaga runs the Tokyo school. He makes Cursed Corpses, animated dolls, of which Panda is the most accomplished.
541a8aad: Who does the Domain Expansion “Coffin of the Iron Mountain” belong to?
Coffin of the Iron Mountain is the domain of Jogo, the volcano curse. It traps its target in a world of lava of unbearable heat.
4d40a6c2: What is the Zen'in family's inherited technique used by Naoya called?
Projection Sorcery is Naoya Zen'in's inherited technique — he divides his movements into 24 frames per second and acts within those intervals, making his attacks almost impossible to follow.
f8b98d38: A congenital binding that trades cursed energy for extreme physical abilities

A Heavenly Restriction is a binding imposed at birth that removes cursed energy in exchange for superhuman physical abilities — Toji Fushiguro has one, which makes him imperceptible to sorcerers while being physically perfect.
5e700c4d: What is Megumi Fushiguro's Domain Expansion?
Chimera Shadow Garden is Megumi's Domain Expansion: he floods it with his shadows and multiplies his shikigami. At first, this domain remains incomplete.
e5cc77b2: What is Kento Nanami's technique that exploits geometric ratios called?

The Ratio Technique divides the target's body at a 7:3 ratio — the 7:3 point is always a structural weak point. Combined with his Overtime (power boosted after working hours), Nanami is formidable and methodical.
5cdfeab0: What is the technique of Hiromi Higuruma, a lawyer turned sorcerer?
Deadly Sentencing opens a courtroom where the target is tried. If found guilty, Higuruma can strip them of their technique, or even sentence them to death with his executioner's sword.
8f63b76d: How does Sukuna take full control of Yuji's body during the Shibuya Incident?
He is made to swallow ten fingers while unconscious
In Shibuya, two of Geto's followers make the unconscious Yuji swallow ten fingers. Sukuna then wakes up and takes control of his body.
fdf51c06: What is the role of Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu High in society?
They train sorcerers to exorcise Cursed Spirits
They are hidden from the public
The two schools train professional jujutsu sorcerers to exorcise Cursed Spirits — they protect ordinary people, who are unaware that curses exist in modern Japan.
9f598cc9: What is Aoi Todo's technique that swaps positions called?
Boogie Woogie lets Todo swap the positions of two targets by clapping his hands. Alongside Yuji, he uses it to throw Hanami and then Mahito off balance.
dc87386e: What is cursed energy and where does it come from?
Energy born from negative human emotions
Cursed energy comes from accumulated negative human emotions — fear, hatred, jealousy, grief. Sorcerers learn to control it to fight the Cursed Spirits born from that same energy.
e7679f09: Who is Panda among the Jujutsu Kaisen characters, and what is his nature?
A Cursed Corpse created by Principal Yaga
Panda is a self-aware Cursed Corpse created by Masamichi Yaga. He has three cores, including a gorilla one, which give him several fighting forms.
1c66ca7a: What is the Culling Game launched by Kenjaku?
A battle forcing awakened players to fight each other under rules
The Culling Game traps awakened sorcerers and reincarnated ancient sorcerers in colonies where they must fight each other under strict rules.
788889a1: How does Nobara Kugisaki use her technique's Resonance?
By holding the target's hair or blood while striking the doll
Nobara holds a piece of her target, such as hair or blood, while driving nails into her doll — Resonance inflicts the same wounds from a distance. The target cannot defend normally.
8b55731f: What happens when two opponents use their Domain Expansions at the same time?
When two domains clash at the same time, the more refined one (the more accomplished technique) generally wins — that is what happens in domain duels between high-level sorcerers.
19881899: Who is Yuki Tsukumo and what is her role in the story?
A former Tokyo student turned teacher
A Special Grade sorcerer seeking to make curses disappear
A member of the council of elders
Yuki Tsukumo is one of the few Special Grade sorcerers. Rather than exorcising curses one by one, she seeks a way to eliminate their source.
da3b2922: What is a Cursed Tool in Jujutsu Kaisen?
An object imbued with cursed energy
An object possessed by a spirit
A weapon stolen from a sorcerer
A Cursed Tool is an object imbued with cursed energy — unlike normal weapons, it can harm Cursed Spirits. Maki uses many of them.
1986b762: How is Gojo finally freed from the Prison Realm?
The technique of Angel, who inhabits Hana Kurusu's body, can cancel other techniques. It is used to open the Prison Realm and free Gojo.
bc67d686: Who is Kinji Hakari and what is his gambling technique?
A sorcerer whose pachinko-style jackpot grants unlimited power

Kinji Hakari is a suspended third-year at Tokyo. His technique works like a pachinko machine: on a jackpot, he gets unlimited cursed energy and regenerates automatically for a little over four minutes.
56085494: Why is Nanami's death particularly striking in the series?
His last words hand things over to Yuji before Mahito finishes him
He dies a hero against Sukuna
Badly burned in Shibuya, Nanami sees Yuji arrive and simply tells him that it's up to him now. Mahito finishes him off before Yuji's eyes.
ce45ef3a: Who is Maki Zen'in and why is she exceptional despite having almost no cursed energy?
A Heavenly Restriction gives her a superhuman body
Maki was born with a Heavenly Restriction: almost no cursed energy, but an extraordinary body. After the death of her sister Mai, her restriction becomes complete and she reaches Toji's level.
88b3462f: What is Yuji's punch whose cursed energy lands just after the physical impact called?
Divergent Fist is Yuji's first original technique — his cursed energy reaches the target slightly after the physical impact, creating a double hit. It is the precursor to his mastery of Black Flash.
05bb218f: Who is Megumi's main human enemy in the Culling Game?
Reggie Star is a sorcerer in the Culling Game who fights Megumi — a strategist who uses receipts as cursed weapons. Megumi has to use everything his technique offers to beat him.
c7c8d0b0: Why is Gojo considered the strongest man?
His Six Eyes and the Limitless technique

The unique combination of the Six Eyes and Limitless sets Gojo apart — his Six Eyes give him perfect perception and efficiency with cursed energy, while Limitless controls space at the level of infinity.
6bd3d6f9: How does the Shibuya Incident affect Gojo's status as a sorcerer?
He is declared an accomplice and banished from the jujutsu world
After Shibuya, the leaders of the jujutsu world brand Gojo an accomplice in the incident, banish him and forbid his release.
f7f51e94: What does Mahoraga represent among Megumi's Ten Shadows shikigami?
The untamable — never tamed by any user in history
The guardian of the Big Three families
Mahoraga, the Divine General, is the most powerful shikigami of the Ten Shadows. No user of this technique has ever managed to tame it, and it adapts to any attack.
82587d6f: Which jujutsu clan is known for the Ten Shadows Technique?
The Ten Shadows is an inherited technique of the Zen'in clan. Megumi, Toji's son, inherited it.
4fbb56f6: What is Satoru Gojo's grade in the sorcerer hierarchy?
Satoru Gojo is Special Grade — the highest rank. He is considered the strongest sorcerer of the modern world, able to stand up alone to all the sorcerers of the Big Three families combined.
31078101: Who is Suguru Geto and what was his link with Gojo in the past?
His best friend, who turned villain after a trauma
Suguru Geto was Gojo's best friend at school. Disgusted by ordinary humans, he snaps after massacring a village and becomes an enemy of sorcerers.
3cfdd580: What is the name of Gojo's invisible barrier that endlessly slows down anything approaching him?
Infinity is an application of the Limitless technique: anything approaching Gojo slows down without ever reaching him.
1ee7545f: Who is Choso and how is he biologically related to Yuji Itadori?
Choso is one of the Death Painting Wombs, born of a woman and a curse, with Kenjaku as father. Yuji was born from Kenjaku in his mother's body: they are therefore half-brothers.
cf8f772f: Which clan is one of the three noble jujutsu clans along with the Gojo and Zen'in?
The Kamo clan is one of the three noble sorcerer families alongside the Gojo and Zen'in — specialized in Blood Manipulation. Noritoshi Kamo represents the clan at the Kyoto school.
6d3c64f7: Who is the author of the Jujutsu Kaisen manga?
Gege Akutami published Jujutsu Kaisen in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2018 to 2024.
14ebba96: MAPPA has produced the series since 2020, as well as the film Jujutsu Kaisen 0.
88115974: Who is the hero of the prequel film Jujutsu Kaisen 0?
Jujutsu Kaisen 0 follows Yuta Okkotsu, a high schooler haunted by the curse of his childhood friend, Rika.
733d1d98: Rika Orimoto, Yuta's childhood friend who died in an accident, became an immensely powerful curse that protects him.
8a9be113: What last wish does Yuji's grandfather leave him?
Before dying, his grandfather asks him to help others and to die surrounded by people. These words guide Yuji throughout the story.
34357fae: Which club is Yuji part of in high school, before becoming an exorcist?
Despite his extraordinary physical abilities, Yuji prefers the Occult Club, where he finds Sukuna's finger.
c8dfac0a: What does Satoru Gojo wear over his eyes most of the time?
Gojo hides his Six Eyes behind a blindfold, or sometimes sunglasses, to spare his perception abilities.
a58a50e7: Which of Gojo's techniques combines the “blue” attraction and the “red” repulsion?
By combining Blue and Red, Gojo creates Purple, an imaginary mass that erases everything in its path.
dce103ca: What question does Aoi Todo ask everyone he meets?
What kind of girl are you into?
How many curses have you killed?
Todo judges people by their answer to “What kind of girl are you into?”. Yuji's answer makes him Todo's “best friend”.
36b02e20: What job did Kento Nanami have before returning to exorcism?
Nanami left the world of exorcism to become a salaryman, before concluding that that kind of work was just as absurd.
88606dcb: What is the name of Maki Zen'in's twin sister?
Mai Zen'in, a student at the Kyoto school, is Maki's twin. Her death allows Maki to reach her full potential.
314bf1ab: Why does Toge Inumaki only speak in rice ball ingredients?
He has been mute since childhood
His Cursed Speech makes his words dangerous
He took a vow of silence
Inumaki's commands actually come true. To avoid hurting anyone, he limits himself to words like “salmon” or “kelp”.
cb154c1c: On what date does the Shibuya Incident take place?
The Shibuya Incident breaks out on Halloween night, October 31, 2018, in the middle of the crowds out to celebrate.
3a10027a: Which shikigami does Megumi summon first with the Ten Shadows?
The Divine Dogs, one white and one black, are Megumi's first shikigami.
8f9c69c4: Choso manipulates his own blood, an inherited technique of the Kamo clan.
49f0c449: From which human fear was the curse Jogo born?
The fear of volcanoes and the earth
Jogo is born from the fear of earth disasters. Hanami embodies the fear of forests and Mahito the hatred humans feel for each other.
6f89fec5: Who kills Satoru Gojo in their great showdown?
After a long duel, Sukuna manages to kill Gojo by slicing through space itself.
78777426: In what year did the Jujutsu Kaisen manga end?
The last chapter, the 271st, came out in September 2024.
